zh-CN.title: 最小化按钮
zh-CN.description: 点岛上的最小化按钮时，隐藏到托盘还是贴到屏幕顶部。

en.title: Minimize button
en.description: Whether the island's minimize button hides it in the tray or tucks it to the top edge.

zh-CN.title: 鼠标移开后收起前等待
悬停切换页面
zh-CN.description: 鼠标停在展开后顶部的页面图标上，就切到那一页，不用点击；划过的图标不会切换

en.title: Switch pages on hover
en.description: Resting the pointer on a page icon at the top of the open island opens that page, no click needed; icons the pointer passes over do not

zh-CN.title: 闲置时贴边隐藏
zh-CN.description: 一段时间没有操作后，岛屿贴到屏幕顶部，只露出一条边。

en.title: Tuck to the edge when idle
en.description: After a while without use, the island slides up to the top of the screen and shows only an edge.

zh-CN.title: 有正在进行的待办时不收起
zh-CN.description: 点了「开始」、岛上正显示这件事时，一直留在屏幕上。

en.title: Stay out while a todo is in progress
en.description: While a todo you started shows on the island, it stays on screen.

zh-CN.title: Agent 在等你时不收起
zh-CN.description: 有会话在等你审批或回答时，一直留在屏幕上。

en.title: Stay out while an agent waits for you
en.description: While a session waits for your approval or answer, the island stays on screen.

zh-CN.title: 音乐播放中不收起
zh-CN.description: 播放音乐时一直留在屏幕上。暂停或停止后，重新从头计时。

en.title: Stay out while music plays
en.description: While music plays, the island stays on screen. Paused or stopped, the idle time starts again.

en.title: Tuck again when the pointer leaves

zh-CN.title: 游戏勿扰
zh-CN.description: 不悬停展开，不抢键盘焦点，不弹消息预览，已展开的面板会收起。消息照常接收。

en.title: Do not disturb in games
en.description: No opening on hover, no taking the keyboard focus, no message pop-ups, and an open panel closes. Messages still arrive.

zh-CN.title: 游戏时贴边隐藏
zh-CN.description: 全屏程序占住岛所在的屏幕时贴到顶部，退出后自动露出。

en.title: Tuck away during games
en.description: Tucks to the top edge while a full-screen app fills the island's screen, and slides back out afterwards.

zh-CN.title: 调节时在小岛上显示
zh-CN.description: 用键盘、任务栏或其他程序调音量或屏幕亮度时，收起的小岛显示当前大小，1.5 秒后恢复。亮度只支持笔记本自带的屏幕。

en.title: Show changes on the island
en.description: When the volume or screen brightness changes, from the keyboard, the taskbar or another app, the collapsed island shows the new level for 1.5 seconds. Brightness works for a laptop's built-in screen only.

zh-CN.title: 在小岛上提示
zh-CN.description: 耳机或蓝牙音频设备连接、断开时，收起的小岛显示 3 秒，蓝牙设备带电量；蓝牙设备电量降到 20% 和 10% 时各提醒一次；笔记本插上或拔掉电源时也会提示。蓝牙电量要设备自己报告给 Windows 才有。

en.title: Show on the island
en.description: When headphones or Bluetooth audio connect or disconnect, the collapsed island says so for 3 seconds, with the battery level of Bluetooth devices. A Bluetooth device warns once at 20% and again at 10%, and a laptop says when its charger is plugged in or pulled out. Bluetooth battery levels show only for devices that report them to Windows.

zh-CN.title: 摄像头和麦克风使用提示
zh-CN.description: 有程序在用摄像头或麦克风时，在小岛上显示绿色摄像头或橙色麦克风图标，点击打开系统的隐私设置。

en.title: Camera and microphone in use
en.description: While an app uses the camera or the microphone, the island shows a green camera or an orange microphone; click it to open Windows' privacy settings.

zh-CN.title: 面板宽度
zh-CN.description: 所有页面都用这个宽度和高度，内容多了在页面里滚动。也可以按住 Alt 拖动展开面板的左右边缘或底边来调。

en.title: Panel width
en.description: Every page has this width and height and scrolls inside when it holds more. Or hold Alt and drag the open panel's side or bottom edge.

zh-CN.title: 配色
zh-CN.description: 深色、浅色各有一套颜色；跟随系统按 Windows 的深色 / 浅色模式在两套之间自动切换。

en.title: Colors
en.description: Dark and light each have their own colors; System switches between them with Windows' dark or light mode.

zh-CN.title: 调整哪一套
zh-CN.description: 下面的颜色改的是这一套，预览也显示这一套。

en.title: Adjusting
en.description: The colors below change this set, and the preview shows it.

zh-CN.title: 收起时保持深色
zh-CN.description: 岛是浅色时，收起的小岛仍然是黑色，和屏幕顶边、刘海融在一起；展开后才变浅色。

en.title: Stay dark when collapsed
en.description: With a light island, the collapsed island stays black so it blends into the screen's top edge and notch; it turns light when it opens.

zh-CN.title: 强调色
zh-CN.description: 焦点框、当前页的图标、链接用的颜色。跟随 Windows 用「设置 → 个性化 → 颜色」里的主题色。

en.title: Accent
en.description: The color of focus rings, the open page's icon and links. Windows uses the accent from Settings > Personalization > Colors.

zh-CN.title: 用 Win+V 打开
zh-CN.description: 按 Win+V 打开岛屿的剪贴板，代替系统自带的剪贴板历史；关掉后 Win+V 还给系统。

en.title: Open with Win+V
en.description: Win+V opens the island's clipboard instead of Windows' own clipboard history; turned off, Win+V goes back to Windows.

zh-CN.title: 调整面板宽高（按住 Alt 时面板不收起）

en.title: Resize the panel (it stays open while Alt is held)

zh-CN.title: 启用待办
zh-CN.description: 关闭后，岛上不再显示这个功能的入口，后台也停止运行；已有数据会保留。

en.title: Enable todos
en.description: When off, the island hides this module and stops its background work. Your data is kept.

zh-CN.title: 空闲时显示剩余待办数
自动将未完成任务写入下一天

en.title: Carry unfinished tasks to next day

zh-CN.title: 允许拖动调整任务顺序
启用日历
zh-CN.description: 关闭后，岛上不再显示这个功能的入口，后台也停止运行；已有数据会保留。

en.title: Enable the calendar
en.description: When off, the island hides this module and stops its background work. Your data is kept.

zh-CN.title: 会前倒计时
zh-CN.description: 会议开始前这么久，收起的小岛显示「标题 · 10 分钟后」，有会议链接时旁边有「加入」按钮。开始后再留 5 分钟。今天的待办以时间开头（例如「15:00 周会」「9:30-10:00 站会」）也会这样倒计时，不用添加日历。

en.title: Countdown before a meeting
en.description: This long before a meeting starts, the collapsed island shows "Title · in 10 min", with a Join button when it has a meeting link. It stays for 5 minutes after the start. Today's todos that start with a time ("15:00 Weekly sync", "9:30-10:00 Standup") count down the same way, with no calendar added.

zh-CN.title: 显示会议标题
zh-CN.description: 关掉后只显示「会议 · 10 分钟后」，共享屏幕时不会露出会议内容。

en.title: Show the meeting's title
en.description: Off shows only "Meeting · in 10 min", so a shared screen does not reveal what the meeting is about.

zh-CN.title: 启用音乐控制
zh-CN.description: 关闭后，岛上不再显示这个功能的入口，后台也停止运行；已有数据会保留。

en.title: Enable music controls
en.description: When off, the island hides this module and stops its background work. Your data is kept.

zh-CN.title: 在收起的岛上显示音乐波形
zh-CN.description: 收起的岛右侧跳动的竖条，点它打开音乐页。和 外观 → 收起条 里「音乐」的显示开关是同一个，位置也在那里调。

en.title: Show the music wave on the collapsed island
en.description: The moving bars on the collapsed island, which open the music page. The same switch as Music under Appearance → Collapsed bar, where it can also be moved.

zh-CN.title: 本地歌词文件夹
zh-CN.description: 放 .lrc 文件，文件名写成「歌手 - 歌名」「歌名 - 歌手」或「歌名」。只找这一层，不找子文件夹。

en.title: Lyrics folder
en.description: Holds .lrc files named "Artist - Title", "Title - Artist" or "Title". Subfolders are not searched.

zh-CN.title: 在线查找歌词
zh-CN.description: 本地找不到时查 LRCLIB（lrclib.net，免费开源的歌词库），会把歌名、歌手、专辑和时长发过去。每首歌只查一次，结果存在本机。中文歌收录较少。

en.title: Find lyrics online
en.description: When the folder has none, asks LRCLIB (lrclib.net, a free and open lyrics library), sending the title, artist, album and length. Each song is asked about once and the answer is kept on this computer.

zh-CN.title: 也查酷狗和网易云
zh-CN.description: 中文歌收录多，有翻译。这两个是非官方接口，可能随时失效；会把歌名、歌手和时长发给它们。装了网易云的 InfLink 插件时按歌曲直接查，更准。

en.title: Also ask Kugou and NetEase
en.description: Many more Chinese songs, with translations. These are unofficial interfaces that may stop working at any time; the title, artist and length are sent to them. With NetEase's InfLink plugin the song is looked up by its id, which is more exact.

zh-CN.title: 网易云精确同步（InfLink-rs）
zh-CN.description: 网易云插件，让网易云把播放进度和歌曲 ID 告诉系统：音乐页有进度条，歌词按歌曲直接查、不会对不上。从 GitHub 下载，放进 BetterNCM 的插件文件夹。

en.title: Exact NetEase sync (InfLink-rs)
en.description: A NetEase Cloud Music plugin that tells Windows the playback position and song id: the music page gets a progress bar, and lyrics are looked up by song and stay in step. Downloaded from GitHub into BetterNCM's plugins folder.

zh-CN.title: 在收起的岛上显示当前歌词
zh-CN.description: 播放中、找到带时间轴的歌词时，收起的岛显示正在唱的那一句；暂停、间奏和没找到歌词时照常显示待办。

en.title: Show the current line on the collapsed island
en.description: While a song plays and synced lyrics are found, the collapsed island shows the line being sung; paused, between verses or without lyrics it shows your todo as usual.

zh-CN.title: 同时有 Agent 在运行时
zh-CN.description: 歌词优先：Agent 开始新会话、跑完或出错时临时显示 4 秒，做到一半等你审批或回答时一直显示到你处理；没找到歌词的歌显示「歌名 - 歌手」。Agent 优先：有 Agent 在运行就显示它，空下来才显示歌词。

en.title: While an agent is running
en.description: Lyrics first: an agent shows for 4 seconds when it starts a session, finishes or fails, and stays while it is stopped on an approval or question; a song without lyrics shows “title - artist”. Agent first: a running agent shows, and lyrics come back when it is idle.

zh-CN.title: 歌词提前或推后
zh-CN.description: 歌词比歌声快就往右调，慢就往左调。

en.title: Lyrics earlier or later
en.description: Move right if the lyrics run ahead of the singing, left if they lag.

zh-CN.title: 逐字高亮
zh-CN.description: 正在唱的那一句从左到右变亮。酷狗歌词和带逐字时间的本地 .lrc 按每个字的时间走。

en.title: Light up as sung
en.description: The line being sung lights up from left to right. Kugou lyrics and local .lrc files with word times follow each word.

zh-CN.title: 没有逐字时间的歌
zh-CN.description: LRCLIB 和网易云的歌词只有每句的时间。按整句填充：在这一句的时间里匀速变亮（最长 8 秒），和歌声大致对得上。

en.title: Songs without word times
en.description: LRCLIB and NetEase lyrics only time each line. Fill the line: it lights evenly over the line's time (at most 8 s), roughly with the singing.

zh-CN.title: 没唱到的字
zh-CN.description: 亮度越低，高亮越显眼。

en.title: Words not sung yet
en.description: The dimmer, the more the highlight stands out.

zh-CN.title: 发光
zh-CN.description: 整句带一圈柔和的光，颜色跟高亮颜色走。

en.title: Glow
en.description: A soft glow around the line, in the highlight colour.

zh-CN.title: 长句跟着滚动
zh-CN.description: 一句比岛宽时，唱到右边缘附近整句往左移，正在唱的字一直看得见。关掉则在末尾用省略号截断。

en.title: Scroll long lines
en.description: A line wider than the island slides left as the singing nears the edge, so the word being sung stays in view. Off, it ends in an ellipsis.

zh-CN.title: 启用快捷翻译
zh-CN.description: 关闭后，岛上不再显示这个功能的入口，后台也停止运行；已有数据会保留。

en.title: Enable quick translation
en.description: When off, the island hides this module and stops its background work. Your data is kept.

zh-CN.title: 打开时填入剪贴板
zh-CN.description: 原文为空时，用最新一条文字剪贴板填上。已有内容不会被覆盖。

en.title: Fill from the clipboard on open
en.description: When the source is empty, fill it from the latest clipboard text. Existing text is left as it is.

zh-CN.title: 停稳后自动翻译
zh-CN.description: 原文停止输入约半秒后自动翻译。未配置密钥时不发送。

en.title: Translate after you pause
en.description: Translate about half a second after the source stops changing. Nothing is sent without an API key.

zh-CN.title: 启用剪贴板历史
zh-CN.description: 关闭后，岛上不再显示这个功能的入口，后台也停止运行；已有数据会保留。

en.title: Enable clipboard history
en.description: When off, the island hides this module and stops its background work. Your data is kept.

zh-CN.title: 快捷键打开
zh-CN.description: 独立窗口在鼠标旁弹出，选中一条直接粘贴到原来的窗口；岛上页面和以前一样，展开岛的剪贴板页。

en.title: The shortcut opens
en.description: The window pops up by the pointer and pastes what you pick into the window you were in; the island page opens the island's clipboard page as before.

zh-CN.title: 选中后自动粘贴
zh-CN.description: 关掉时只复制，回到原来的窗口自己按 Ctrl+V。

en.title: Paste what you pick
en.description: Off: it is only copied, and you press Ctrl+V back in your window.

zh-CN.title: 粘贴图片到终端时贴文件路径
zh-CN.description: Windows Terminal 等终端里粘贴图片时改贴它的文件路径，Claude Code 会把路径当成图片附上（直接粘贴位图常常贴不上）。

en.title: Paste images into terminals as their path
en.description: In Windows Terminal and other terminals an image is pasted as its file path, which Claude Code attaches as an image (pasting the bitmap often fails there).

zh-CN.title: 识别图片里的文字
zh-CN.description: 用 Windows 自带的文字识别在本机识别，不联网。识别出的文字可以搜索，也可以单独复制。

en.title: Read the text in images
en.description: Windows' own text recognition, on this computer, offline. The text can be searched and copied on its own.

zh-CN.title: 记录复制的文件
zh-CN.description: 在资源管理器里复制的文件也进历史，粘贴回去仍是文件；贴到终端里是文件路径。

en.title: Record copied files
en.description: Files copied in Explorer join the history and paste back as files; into a terminal they go as paths.

zh-CN.title: 保留格式
zh-CN.description: 从网页、Word 复制的文字连同格式一起记下，粘贴时带格式；独立窗口里按 Shift+Enter 粘贴成纯文本。

en.title: Keep formatting
en.description: Text copied from web pages or Word keeps its formatting when pasted; Shift+Enter in the window pastes plain text.

zh-CN.title: 不记录密码
zh-CN.description: 密码管理器（KeePass、Bitwarden、1Password 等）复制的密码带着「不要记录」的标记，和系统剪贴板历史一样跳过它们。

en.title: Do not record passwords
en.description: Password managers (KeePass, Bitwarden, 1Password...) mark the passwords they copy; like Windows' own clipboard history, these are skipped.

zh-CN.title: 密钥和令牌
zh-CN.description: 看起来像 API Key、GitHub 令牌、私钥的内容：打码显示（粘贴时仍是原文）、不记录，或照常记录。

en.title: Keys and tokens
en.description: What looks like an API key, GitHub token or private key: shown masked (pasted as it is), not recorded, or recorded as usual.

zh-CN.title: 不记录这些程序复制的内容
zh-CN.description: 填程序名，逗号分隔，比如 keepass.exe。每条记录旁边会显示它来自哪个程序。

en.title: Do not record copies from these programs
en.description: Program names separated by commas, such as keepass.exe. Each entry shows the program it came from.

zh-CN.title: 自动清理
zh-CN.description: 超过这个时间没再复制过的记录自动删除，收藏的不删。

en.title: Clean up
en.description: Entries not copied again for this long are deleted; favourites stay.

zh-CN.title: 导出剪贴板历史
zh-CN.description: 历史记录（含图片）和常用片段写成一个 JSON 文件，放在「下载」文件夹。里面可能有你复制过的密码和私人内容，注意保管。

en.title: Export the clipboard history
en.description: The entries (with images) and snippets go into one JSON file in Downloads. It may hold passwords and private things you copied; keep it safe.

zh-CN.title: 从文件导入
zh-CN.description: 导入另一台电脑导出的文件：只加入这里还没有的记录和片段，不删除任何东西。

en.title: Import from a file
en.description: A file exported on another computer: only entries and snippets not here yet are added, nothing is removed.

zh-CN.title: 启用文件中转
zh-CN.description: 关闭后，岛上不再显示这个功能的入口，后台也停止运行；已有数据会保留。

en.title: Enable the file shelf
en.description: When off, the island hides this module and stops its background work. Your data is kept.

en.title: Open when files are dragged in
Show the file count when collapsed

zh-CN.title: 自动移除已失效的文件

en.title: Remove files that were moved or deleted

zh-CN.title: 显示联系人和消息摘要
zh-CN.description: 把正在运行的微信里控制辅助功能的一个字节从 0 改成 1，微信就像开着读屏软件一样公开界面，提醒卡片能显示联系人和摘要，点卡片进入那个聊天。只改内存，微信重启后自动再改，关掉时改回。这是微信没有公开支持的做法，会多占一些 CPU 和内存，腾讯可能视为异常行为。微信关在托盘里时读不到，最小化可以。

en.title: Show the contact and message
en.description: Sets one accessibility byte inside the running WeChat from 0 to 1, so WeChat exposes its interface as it would to a screen reader: reminder cards then show the contact and message and open that chat. Memory only; done again after WeChat restarts and undone when turned off. WeChat does not support this, it costs WeChat some CPU and memory, and Tencent may treat it as unusual behaviour. Nothing can be read while WeChat is closed to the tray; minimized works.

zh-CN.title: 启用邮箱
zh-CN.description: 关闭后，岛上不再显示这个功能的入口，后台也停止运行；已有数据会保留。

en.title: Enable mail
en.description: When off, the island hides this module and stops its background work. Your data is kept.

zh-CN.title: 启用 AI Agent 状态灯
zh-CN.description: 关闭后，岛上不再显示这个功能的入口，后台也停止运行；已有数据会保留。

en.title: Enable the AI Agent status light
en.description: When off, the island hides this module and stops its background work. Your data is kept.

zh-CN.title: 在小岛显示会话标题
zh-CN.description: 在待办的位置显示 Agent 图标和会话标题。标题直接读取 Claude Code 和 Codex 的会话记录，不需要安装钩子。

en.title: Show the session title on the island
en.description: Shows the agent icon and session title where the todo goes. Titles are read from the Claude Code and Codex session files, so no hooks are needed.

zh-CN.title: 什么时候显示
zh-CN.description: 有变化时：会话开始、跑完或出错时显示 4 秒，等你确认时一直显示到你处理，其余时间留给待办和中心图案。运行时一直显示：有 Agent 在运行就显示，结束 3 秒后恢复待办。

en.title: When to show it
en.description: On changes: for 4 seconds when a session starts, finishes or fails, and while it waits for your approval; otherwise the todo and the center pattern stay. While running: the whole time an agent runs, then the todo again 3 seconds after it finishes.

zh-CN.title: 状态灯样式
zh-CN.description: 收起条上 Agent 状态灯的样子。悬岛：应用图标的白胶囊，和条上的环一样高；绿点呼吸，运行时短横换成三个依次亮起的点，等你确认时变黄闪烁，失败或可能中断时变红，跑完打勾。圆点：原来的小圆点。

en.title: Status light
en.description: How the Agent status light looks on the collapsed bar. Island mark: the app icon's white pill, as tall as the rings on the bar; its light breathes, three dots take the dash's place while running, it turns yellow and blinks while waiting for you, red when failed or possibly stopped, and shows a tick when done. Dot: the original small dot.

zh-CN.title: 列出多久内的会话
zh-CN.description: 最后一次活动在这段时间内的会话才会列出。

en.title: List sessions from the last
en.description: Only sessions active within this time are listed.

zh-CN.title: 只显示进行中的会话
zh-CN.description: 隐藏已完成和失败的会话，只留正在运行、等待确认和可能中断的。

en.title: Only sessions in progress
en.description: Hide finished and failed sessions; keep running, waiting and possibly stalled ones.

zh-CN.title: 隐藏已退出的会话
zh-CN.description: Claude Code 或 Codex 已经退出的会话不再列出，SessionEnd hook 没触发也算：按进程是否还在判断，远程电脑上的 Claude Code 会话同样适用。

en.title: Hide sessions that have quit
en.description: Sessions whose Claude Code or Codex has quit are no longer listed, even when the SessionEnd hook did not run: told by whether the process still runs, for Claude Code sessions on remote computers too.

zh-CN.title: 在顶部显示 Claude 用量
zh-CN.description: 5 小时、7 天和各模型的用量，以及最紧的那个何时重置。读的是 claude-hud 状态栏保存的用量文件（它的 externalUsagePath 或 externalUsageWritePath 设置）；没有时不显示。

en.title: Show Claude usage at the top
en.description: The 5-hour, 7-day and per-model usage, and when the fullest resets. Read from the usage file the claude-hud status line keeps (its externalUsagePath or externalUsageWritePath setting); hidden without one.

zh-CN.title: 显示方式
zh-CN.description: 卡片：每个会话一张按状态颜色描边的卡片，第二行写它在做什么和上下文大小。紧凑：每个会话一行，只有状态色条、标题、状态和时间。

en.title: Layout
en.description: Cards: one card per session, framed in its state's colour, with what it is doing and its context size on the second line. Compact: one line per session with only the state bar, title, state and time.

zh-CN.title: 归档动画
zh-CN.description: 滑出：会话向右滑出再收起。粒子消散：会话从左到右化成状态颜色的粒子散开再收起。系统要求减少动画时直接移除。

en.title: Archive animation
en.description: Slide: the session slides out to the right, then folds away. Dissolve: it turns into dust in its state's colour from left to right, then folds away. When Windows asks for less motion it goes at once.

zh-CN.title: 卡片光效
zh-CN.description: 只在「卡片」和「紧凑」显示方式下生效。粒子流苏：边框按状态颜色发光，进行中和等你处理的会呼吸，左侧飘着一条粒子流苏。渐变带：从右端铺开一层状态颜色的渐变，进行中和等你处理的更亮。

en.title: Card light effects
en.description: Only in the Cards and Compact layouts. Sparkle band: cards glow in their state's colour, breathing while working or waiting on you, with a drifting band of sparks on the left. Gradient: a wash in that colour from the right end, brighter while working or waiting on you.

zh-CN.title: 会话来源
zh-CN.description: 会话在哪个程序里运行，比如 Orca、Windows Terminal、VS Code、Codex。正在运行的 Claude Code 会话会自动识别；岛屿启动前就结束的会话没有来源。

en.title: Session source
en.description: The program a session runs in, such as Orca, Windows Terminal, VS Code or Codex. Running Claude Code sessions are recognized automatically; sessions that ended before the island started have no source.

zh-CN.title: 显示最近提问和正在用的工具
zh-CN.description: 进行中的会话在回复上方显示你最近一次的提问，运行时显示它正在调用的工具（如 Bash 命令、正在改的文件）。

en.title: Show the latest prompt and the tool in use
en.description: Sessions in progress show your latest prompt above the reply and, while running, the tool they are calling (a Bash command, the file being edited).

zh-CN.title: 显示运行时长
zh-CN.description: 进行中的会话显示"已运行多久"，每秒更新；结束的显示这一轮"用时多久"。从最近一次提问开始算。

en.title: Show how long it has run
en.description: A session in progress shows how long it has been running, updated every second; a finished one shows how long its last turn took. Counted from the latest prompt.

zh-CN.title: 显示 Claude Code 会话

en.title: When it waits for your approval or answer

zh-CN.title: 没处理时再提醒
zh-CN.description: 等你确认或回答的会话过了这么久还在等，再弹一次并再响一次；每次等待只补一次

en.title: Remind again
en.description: If a session is still waiting for your approval or answer this long, pop up and sound once more; once per wait

zh-CN.title: 额度提醒
zh-CN.description: Claude 或 Codex 的 5 小时、7 天用量到这条线时，在收起的岛屿上提醒一次；额度刷新后再提醒一次

en.title: Usage alert
en.description: When Claude's or Codex's 5-hour or 7-day usage reaches this level, say so once on the collapsed island, and again when it resets

zh-CN.title: 推送到手机
zh-CN.description: Agent 等你、完成或出错时推到手机：iPhone 上的 Bark，或 cc-connect 在 Telegram、Discord、飞书上的机器人

en.title: Push to your phone
en.description: When an agent needs you, finishes or fails, push it to your phone: Bark on an iPhone, or cc-connect's bot on Telegram, Discord or Feishu

zh-CN.title: 服务器地址
zh-CN.description: 留空用 Bark 官方服务器；自建 bark-server 时填它的地址

en.title: Server
en.description: Leave empty for Bark's own server; for a self-hosted bark-server, enter its address

zh-CN.title: 设备 Key
zh-CN.description: 在 Bark 里复制推送地址粘贴进来，或只粘贴其中那串字母数字

en.title: Device key
en.description: Copy the push URL in Bark and paste it here, or just the letters and digits in it

zh-CN.title: 什么时候推
zh-CN.description: 锁屏立即推；没锁屏时没有键盘鼠标操作满这么久才推。离开前在电脑上看过的不再推，坐在电脑前时不打扰手机

en.title: When to push
en.description: At once when the screen is locked; otherwise after this long without keyboard or mouse. What you looked at on the computer before leaving is not pushed, so the phone stays quiet while you sit there

zh-CN.title: AI Agent 音效
zh-CN.description: Agent 开始、完成、出错或等你处理时播放提示音。

en.title: AI agent sounds
en.description: Plays a sound when an agent starts, finishes, fails or needs you.

zh-CN.title: 会话开始
zh-CN.description: 新的 Claude Code 或 Codex 会话

en.title: Session starts
en.description: A new Claude Code or Codex session

zh-CN.title: 任务完成
zh-CN.description: Agent 完成了这一轮回复

en.title: Task done
en.description: The agent finished its turn

zh-CN.title: 任务出错
zh-CN.description: 这一轮失败或接口出错

en.title: Task failed
en.description: The turn failed or the API returned an error

zh-CN.title: 需要审批
zh-CN.description: 等你允许它执行操作

en.title: Needs approval
en.description: Waiting for you to allow an action

zh-CN.title: 需要回答
zh-CN.description: Claude 向你提了一个问题

en.title: Needs an answer
en.description: Claude asked you a question

zh-CN.title: 发出消息
zh-CN.description: 你给会话发了新的提问

en.title: Prompt sent
en.description: You sent a session a new prompt

zh-CN.title: 上下文快满
zh-CN.description: Claude Code 开始压缩上下文

en.title: Context nearly full
en.description: Claude Code starts compacting its context

zh-CN.title: 闲置等你
zh-CN.description: 会话完成 5 分钟后你还没看过

en.title: Waiting for you
en.description: A session finished 5 minutes ago and you haven't looked

zh-CN.title: 额度快用完
zh-CN.description: Claude 或 Codex 的用量到了提醒线

en.title: Usage running low
en.description: Claude's or Codex's usage reached your alert level

zh-CN.title: 额度已刷新
zh-CN.description: 到过提醒线的额度重置了

en.title: Usage reset
en.description: A limit that reached your alert level has reset

zh-CN.title: 会话的窗口在前台时不响
zh-CN.description: 你已经在看这个终端或编辑器时不再提醒。会话开始和发出消息不受影响。

en.title: Quiet while the session's window is in front
en.description: No sound when you are already looking at that terminal or editor. Session starts and sent prompts still play.

zh-CN.title: 静音时段
zh-CN.description: 这段时间里不播放任何音效；结束时间早于开始时间就跨过午夜。

en.title: Quiet hours
en.description: No sounds at all in this time; an end before the start runs past midnight.

zh-CN.title: 在岛上允许或拒绝 Agent 的操作

en.title: Allow or deny agent actions on the island

zh-CN.title: 终端在前台时也在岛上弹出
zh-CN.description: 关闭时，会话所在的终端或编辑器窗口在前台，就直接在终端里审批。

en.title: Also while the terminal is in front
en.description: Off, a request from a session whose terminal or editor window is in front is approved in that terminal.

zh-CN.title: 让 Claude 在回复末尾标出在等什么（推荐打开）

en.title: Have Claude mark what it waits for at the end of each reply (recommended)

zh-CN.title: 插件目录
zh-CN.description: C:\Users\demo\AppData\Roaming\com.tixxin.fuyu\plugins

en.title: Plugins folder
en.description: C:\Users\demo\AppData\Roaming\com.tixxin.fuyu\plugins

zh-CN.title: 诊断信息
zh-CN.description: 预览并复制应用版本、系统和更新状态，便于反馈问题。

en.title: Diagnostics
en.description: Preview and copy the app version, system and update status for a bug report.

zh-CN.title: 重置所有设置
zh-CN.description: 外观、行为和各功能的设置恢复默认。待办、笔记、邮箱、插件、密钥、样式预设和界面语言都保留。

en.title: Reset all settings
en.description: Appearance, behaviour and every feature's settings go back to their defaults. Todos, notes, mailboxes, plugins, keys, style presets and the interface language are kept.

zh-CN.title: 退出岛屿
zh-CN.description: 和托盘菜单里的「退出」一样；要再打开，从开始菜单或桌面快捷方式启动。

en.title: Quit the island
en.description: Same as Quit in the tray menu; start it again from the Start menu or a desktop shortcut.
